hebrewText: וְ/יָשִׂ֥ימוּ בֵֽ/אלֹהִ֗ים כִּ֫סְלָ֥/ם וְ/לֹ֣א יִ֭שְׁכְּחוּ מַֽעַלְלֵי אֵ֑ל וּ/מִצְוֺתָ֥י/ו יִנְצֹֽרוּ

tokens.bdb: to put (used in a great variety of applications, literal, figurative, inferentially, and elliptically)

tokens.bdb: properly, fatness, i.e. by implication (literally) the loin (as the seat of the leaf fat) or (generally) the viscera; also (figuratively) silliness or (in a good sense) trust
not (the simple or abs. negation); by implication, no; often used with other particles
tokens.kjv: [idiom] before, [phrase] or else, ere, [phrase] except, ig(-norant), much, less, nay, neither, never, no((-ne), -r, (-thing)), ([idiom] as though...,(can-), for) not (out of), of nought, otherwise, out of, [phrase] surely, [phrase] as truly as, [phrase] of a truth, [phrase] verily, for want, [phrase] whether, without.
tokens.explanation: lo — negação absoluta em hebraico: não, nunca, jamais

tokens.bdb: to mislay, i.e. to be oblivious of, from want of memory or attention
strength; as adjective, mighty; especially the Almighty (but used also of any deity)
tokens.kjv: God (god), [idiom] goodly, [idiom] great, idol, might(-y one), power, strong. Compare names in '-el.'

tokens.bdb: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
tokens.kjv: besieged, hidden thing, keep(-er, -ing), monument, observe, preserve(-r), subtil, watcher(-man).
